newsitem.title: THAILAND: Two more Thai brokers say studying merger plans.
newsitem.headline: Two more Thai brokers say studying merger plans.

text.p: Thailand' s SCF Finance and Securities Plc and Siam City Credit Finance and Securities Plc are considering merger plans, they said in statements on Tuesday.
"On the merger issue, a study is being conducted on the possibility, advantages and disadvantages," SCCF said in a statement.

Several Thai finance and securities firms have announced merger plans as the sector struggles to cope with declining revenues, high funding costs and a deterioration in asset quality in the face of the country's worst economic downturn since the mid-1980s.
The central bank last month suspended the operations of 16 distressed finance and securities firms and appointed five large brokers to lead consolidation in the sector.
SCCF shares were up 0.30 baht to 8.60 baht by 0739 GMT. SCF stock was unchanged at 7.70. The two firms are the two main listed finance and securities houses attached to Siam City Bank Plc.
